svg.title: Fat marker sketch
svg.desc:
A · Map with a sidebar - place: Plot map - affordance: Zoom in - affordance: Previous plot - affordance: Next plot - place: Legend (in Plot map) - affordance: Show water taps (in Legend) - place: Sidebar - affordance: Book a plot - place: Filters (in Sidebar) - affordance: Sunny plots (in Filters) - affordance: Shady plots (in Filters) - affordance: Reset - place: Saved searches (in Sidebar) - place: Footer - affordance: Help - affordance: Contact the garden
B · Stacked - place: Plot map - affordance: Book a plot - place: Legend (in Plot map) - place: Booking - place: Waiting list - affordance: Join the waiting list - affordance: Leave it
